Title: Windows Server 2022 is now available in public preview

Body.Content:
Windows Server 2022 introduces advanced multi-layer security, hybrid capabilities with Azure, and a flexible application platform. With this new release, you can:

  • Apply advanced multi-layer protection against threats enabled easily with secured-core server.
  • Secure connectivity to business-critical assets with latest in network security innovation.
  • Use improved tools for hybrid server management in Windows Admin Center.
  • Easily migrate file servers from on-premises to Azure with new supported scenario in Storage Migration Service.
  • Improve container application deployment with smaller image size for faster download and simplified network policy implementation.
  • Accelerate modernization of .NET applications with the new containerization tool in Windows Admin Center.

Learn more in our blog. Preview build is available on Azure today to Windows Insiders.
